review_text: Terrible. It is a very thick heavy cream that goes on green looking but gives a tinted moisture makeup look. It looks like a thin film of makeup on ur skin. It was harder to wash off than normal sunscreen. I’m so glad it was only a sample I had. Not recommended.
So creamy and luxurious, light vanilla scent. Leaves my lips soft and smooth.

I got the travel version of the serum in exchange for an honest review (gifted by Rose Inc). The dropper on the travel version is not good, it barely picks up product, and when I put the dropper back in the bottle, the serum leaks out. Not sure if these problems occur with a full size version. The serum itself is good, it doesn’t leave white cast on my face and doesn’t leave my skin oily / sticky. It’s not drying either. I feel like it creates a film on top of my skin, I tried wearing it on a day when I went to the gym and my face felt weird, like I was wearing a waterproof mask. But for everyday use it’s quite good (no gym for me lol).

I very much enjoyed this product! I felt a difference on my skin within ten minutes. This product applies nicely and doesnt leave a heavy, oily feeling on your face either. The smell is sort of off putting, but not in a bad way! I would definitely reccomend this to my friends looking for a good moisturizer!

I received this eye cream free in exchange for an honest review and I’m so glad I did! This is a creamy texture but it’s not too thick. A little goes a long way, so I think it will last quite awhile. It feels like it melts into my skin. I love that they use naturally sourced ingredients. After a week of use, my under eye is smoother and my concealer doesn’t look cakey anymore. I can’t wait to see the difference in another few weeks. I’m really impressed with this and will definitely purchase some!

I never review products, but this one is worth it! I am 27 and have oily/combination skin that is extremely breakout prone and I use Differin to keep breakouts under control. I use this oil in the morning after Differin and before a light moisturizer, and also at night under a night cream. This stuff is nothing short of amazing. It has really brightened my (ALWAYS dull) complexion, and I have noticed that discoloration and acne scars on my cheeks have started to fade after 1 month of use. Don’t let the “oil“ scare you if you have oily skin--this balances my skin out perfectly, and I can tell the difference if I skip a day. I will never be without this oil again!

This vitamin C serum is gifted by Farmacy Beauty. I haven’t used other vitamin C serum product so this one is very different from other serum I used before. The texture is quite oily and feels greasy. You have to wait quite some time for it to fully absorb. I have used it for a few days and haven’t noticed much change so far.
This serum is sensational. And the price is amazing!  I use it alone as well as under my moisturizer. Absorbs well and doesn’t leave a residue or greasy feeling. Highly recommend!

This is eye cream has a very light texture that goes on smoothly and leaves no greasy or sticky feel under my eyes. I also like that it wears well under makeup. For long term effects I can’t say for now but I have hope because I really like dermalogica products.

I think I found my new holy grail cleanser! I have acne prone skin. Weird skin type, between oily, combination and some parts are dry. But definitely acne all over! I’ve been using this for almost a month now, and no complaints yet! Together with the toner, this is amazing! I use it with my Clarisonic Mia1, and works well. Plus the scent is amazing, feels refreshing and relaxing.

I have been using it for a few months, and I’m in love.  Its absolutely unbelievable.  Its rich, creamy texture glides so nicely under my eye.  Its hydrating AND moisturizing which is great.  The tiny bit of gold mica reflects off and delivers the most beautiful under eye glow.

I honestly LOVE this product. I have very oily skin so most products don’t help or make it worse. However, I found that this product helped my skin look amazing and even helped with my oily face. This product makes my pores disappear and makes me more confidant in my natural skin. Hands down my favorite product I have tried!

I use this product as a daily moisturizer and I don’t have anything negative to say about it. I love the thick formula and it doesn’t leave my face feeling tacky. I have combination skin and think it works great for this type of skin and if you are on the dry side as well. I received this product complimentary for review purposes but all opinions are my own
This cream is very good for daily use and does not leave your face sticky, it is very good for sensitive skin, I highly recommend it

I am on Retin-A Micro and Onexton topical gels to treat my acne, so sunscreen is an essential step in my skin regime. It is hard to find a high SPF, non-greasy sunscreen that does not contain ingredients that conflict with my prescription gels. I received a sample packet of this, and it is my favorite by far! I cleanse, apply Onexton, then mix the Supergoop with my moisturizer: it doesn’t feel heavy on my face at all! It’s super lightweight, spreads nicely, and smells great! Not only is it minimal ingredient, Supergoop is cruelty free as well! I’d happily apply Supergoop to my face and body.

Caudalíe Vinosource-Hydra Moisturizing Mask is the type of mask I would use if I went out all night drinking, stayed up all night working on an test or paper. I wouldn’t use it as often as I would If the seasons were different. This will come in handy when the dry cold season hits that’s when I have to most problematic with my face needing moisture. I usually do the 10 minutes waits to wash it off, than to have it to stay on overnight because it feels heavy or  it’sIf I’m using too much product on my face because I do have fuzzies and lint sticking on my face the next morning and my face is just looking a little bit shiny and it doesn’t look great looking in the mirror waking up until I wash it all off. I am grateful to receive this #FreeProduct with #TryItWithTopbox.

I really like this moisturizer. Initially, I disliked the smell (I assume it’s the natural smell of bakuchiol), but I’ve come to really love it. It’s a super lightweight moisturizer - I use it almost as a thick serum, with either a thicker moisturizer or sunscreen over top for more hydration since I have dry skin. Does it work for anti aging? No idea. It’s certainly not a magic bullet. But it’s an affordable, very lightweight moisturizer that works in my routine and *may* have some anti-aging benefits, so I enjoy continuing to use it.

This premier cru anti-aging cream moisturizing with hyaluronic acid it’s really nice first off the package it is beautiful very luxurious it’s heavy it’s glass it’s refillable which is very nice when it comes to the product itself the cream is nice and creamy a little bit goes a long ways it does have a bit of a smell to it so if you’re not really liking smells I would first find this in stores and smell it other than that it seems to moisturize the skin very nicely plump it up and make your skin look very hydrated#trywithtopbox #Freeproduct

I don’t know. Maybe i’m missing something because this is such an ineffectual and bland toner. It doesn’t do much of anything and leaves a weird sticky film on your face. Other (even plant based/ fragrance free) toners have much better smells and actually DO something.  I will say I tend to prefer a sort of astringent-y effect to my toners the kind with a tightening effect and/or a eucalyptus type tingle. This is not that. If you want something a little thicker and weaker than other toners, (I find it comparable to a lot of mid range drug store serums, actually) then you could get this I guess. But it’s not really as good as people claim. I expected more.

i’ve been excited to do my skincare since it’s so cute. it leaves a sticky feeling but I don’t mind. i’ve been feeling more confident about my skin since i’ve started using this. i just wish it smelled like watermelon!’
By far the best moisturizer I have tried in a long time!!! It smells amazing and my skin is not oily at all but still super soft. I will definitely repurchase this product.

After seeing countless Tik toks on how great this sunscreen was, I figured it was worth a try. Sadly, I don’t get the hype at all. I do have to say it stands by its name for being “unseen” and is a great option if you have issues with sunscreens leaving white cast or not being opaque enough. However, that’s about where my “ooh ahh” factor ends with this product. It does have a very soft feel for texture, but feels very silicone heavy once on my face. Literally reminds me of SmashBox Photo Finish Primer, but with SPF. I never break out from products, this one made me break out like a 13 year old. First product that has done that to me in years. For $30, this is meh in a bottle for me.  I’ll pass on the pimple party and stick with my Paula’s a choice Youth Extender.

Tried a deluxe sample of the Rich Cream from Sephora. I heard soooo many good things about this moisturizer I was prepared to love, even for the high priced tag. Well luckily for my wallet, the Rich Cream turned out to be a total dud. I’m a huge advocate of serums, since serums are where the most concentrated and percentage of actives are found. So for my moisturizer, I want something very occlusive to lock in my retinol or other actives contained in my serums. The Rich Cream was not rich… it was even more so on the watery side. I love Drunk Elephant’s LaLa Retro cream, it’s so nourishing and occlusive. I mix with a few drops of Marula oil for extra nourishment. I will continue to use LaLa Retro over Paula’s Choice 1% Retinol serum, it’s a very effective combo and for 1/3 of the price of the “Rich Cream.”

Excellent toner which I enjoyed for my combination skin. I like that it is not so watery and not too thick. It absorbs well into my skin. I like that it does help make my pores look smoother while having a great AHA or PHA. Gifted by Benefit Cosmetics.

I have gotten this lovely product complimentary from Paula’s Choice and since my skin has been super oily lately I’m glad they did send me this product it doesn’t take off the oily sensation completely but it lessons it which is really great.

Really thought this would help. Like really really.... it caused cystic acne and little bumps. Even around my ear and eye area. My skin is oily in t zone and for head, inner cheeks and nose. But it also is dry and gets skin flakes. This was not good for me. How does this have such good reviews?

I received this complimentary from the brand and have been using it consistently every night in place of an eye cream. I really love the texture, very smooth and creamy! I didn’t notice much in the brightening aspect, but for someone who normally has drier undereyes this is great for staying hydrated! I have seen some changes for my fine lines, but I haven’t been using it long enough to have it be very noticeable.

I cannot get enough of this product!  It melts away all the makeup on your face. Since I have combination skin, I do find it a bit greasy but I think that’s what I like. It forces me to wash my face twice and I know that all my makeup is gone and my skin feels soft supple and clean when I’m done! This is now a staple product for me!
I live in India so I live in a humid and hot climate, I have oily skin and this makes me so greasy hence I will not repurchase.

I’m not usually one to write reviews, but I really feel like I should write one about this oil. It is AMAZING. A few youtubers I follow suggested it so I decided to purchase it and give it a shot. It really does help. It has softened my skin and has made it so my texture isn’t as visible. It also helps me combat oily skin. I used to have very oily skin before using this but after months of including this in my routine, my skin now only gets oily at the end of the day. I can’t believe how cheap this stuff is, too. Everyone should give it a try.

The eye cream comes in a glass bottle with a pump. One pump gives a generous amount of the eye cream that it can be even layered 2 times. The eye cream has very nourishing and rich texture, however it doesn’t feel greasy on my under eye. It doesn’t irritate my eyes either. The under eye looks and feels very moisturized and nourished with visible less wrinkles and fine lines.

I think this cleanser smells amazing and does a good job of getting makeup off. But I have to say it does seem to dry my skin a bit. Not terribly. But enough that I probably won’t buy it again. This is probably great for oily types. My skin has been especially dry since having a baby and turning 30. I tend to prefer a cleansing balm or a cream cleanser, and that’s just a preference, but since this cleanser advertises that it works for all skin types I knocked off a star. I think it’s a bit pricey as well, for being a pretty basic gel cleanser. However, a little goes a long way. If you bought the big bottle it would definitely last a while. If it replaced your makeup remover and your cleanser it could be worth the cost.

I was a huge fan of the original, but I like this one even more! It’s more lightweight than the original but has the same plumping and moisturizing feel. I have oily skin and the original I could only use at night, whereas this one feels great under makeup too. Love the rose scent too!

I’ve only used it for 3 days but so far i love the texture, it’s not sticky at all and very smooth. I haven’t seen any results yet but i have high hopes. And the packaging is very cute as always. Love it

I’ve been using the cleanser (both foam & enzyme) from the DST line. I love them both and decided to try other products. This serum is great. It quickly absorbs into the skin and doesn’t leave that sticky feeling like others I’ve tried (e.g. drugstore cheaper versions). I recommend giving this a try. I have this 4 stars bc of price. I wish it were cheaper. Buying is definitely a splurge. I have to save to buy. A little goes a long way though. Give it a try!

It’s very similar to the Khiels face cream with SPF, but not as thick, they both have similar active ingredients but superscreen has a higher SPF and is oil free. This cream is bouncy and hydrating but gives the skin a slight sheen. I noticed that if I fall asleep with it on, it make my face oily overnight. It’s unscented so no added fragrance but it does have its own original scent which took some getting used to because it lingers on the face and I’m very sensitive to smells. Overall I am excited to keep it in my routine as my skin gets accustomed to the formulas and the touted benefits are too good to pass up. I tend to have combination skin and I’m in my twenties.

A great night cream. It smells delicious (but for those of you who might be scent sensitive like myself, the scent doesn’t linger). It feels great on the skin and it makes you look refreshed in the morning. I also think it’s very moisturizing while not being too thick.

I got this inside my Nov/Dec Skin Wonderland kit as a .33oz deluxe Sample. That lasted about 12 days of use! and made my skin amazing. At first I didn’t know what to think because when I first put it on, it makes my skin really shiny and almost sticky feeling (So I only wore it at night), and it smells like really really strong lemons (I came to love the smell actually). But when I woke up the next day I was amazed. All the acne scars and weird uneven pigment in my face from being pregnant all these months, was 80% better. Just from one night. I wish the price tag wasn’t so high, but it is definitely worth it for perfect skin. I also wore it underneath my primer, and makeup a couple of times and it gave me a glowy look. So that was cool knowing I could use it day or night!

It’s not greasy looking, blends in well and just disappears on my skin. Doesn’t leave the white cast, look greasy or sting my eyes like the other one I bought from here last year from another brand did. It wore well over my homemade Vitamin C & HA serum, the Ordinarys alpha arbutrin serum & ferulic acid/resveratrol serum and the oil that I appied first. I also applied some around my eyes after I moisterized them first and at the end of the day no stinging! I didn’t need a moisturizer and I have normal to dry skin (I’m 52). It doesn’t feel like I’m wearing an SPF at all, it feels more like a moisturizer to me.This is the best one I have ever used and I love that it doesn’t have any silicones and is all mineral because I can’t wear chemical SPF. I will wear SPF every day now. It’s a wonderful product and unless I find something better I’ll be sticking with this as a “daily“ SPF and that’s a first for me.

This was an okay moisturizer. I’ll definitely use it, but it won’t be something I’ll gravitate towards. It didn’t feel hydrating but more like a watery cream that warmed up super easy and sat on the skin? Like I said, okay, but not for me I guess.

I’ve heard a lot of hype about Rosebud lip balm so I tried the strawberry and I guess I don’t really know what the big deal is. It goes on very thin, wears away very, very quickly and is kind of oily in consistency. There are way better lip balms out there. Rosebud, not so much.

Upon first use of this moisturizer, I was thrown off and did not think I would like it at all. However, after using it for a week, my skin felt refreshed- it didn’t look greasy an hour or two later like usual after using a moisturizer, and the scent is something that’s grown on me! My skin feels clarified and refreshed and I feel like it looks great! I only have tiny blackheads and whiteheads but I am really enjoying this moisturizer for my combo skin. However, be warned— this product does not do well with other things on top! Facial oil serum etc. can make it pull off a bit so be careful. Same thing happens if you rub your face after application. Overall I will be using all of this jar! I received this complimentary from Influenster for testing purposes.

I received a small sample of this cream free from Topbox. I used it every night for a week and once in the morning. It is a moderately thick cream that soaked in quickly. I have dry skin and it didn’t feel moisturizing enough for me to use as a night cream but I gave it a chance and when I woke up my skin felt soft and moist. I used this over a night serum and had no layering issues like pilling. When I used this in the day under my sunscreen it also layered well.I think this might be best for skin that isn’t super dry like mine but I made it work with a moisturizing serum underneath.  I can’t speak to any long term improvements. #freeproduct
Love super thick and last all night wake up still feeling refreshed

This has gotten so many negative reviews--and I had such a disappointing experience with Unseen Sunscreen (in the sense that it isn’t a good primer)--that I hesitated to try it. But at 47 I’m finally getting serious about sunscreen and trying to figure out how to reapply the dang stuff when I’m wearing a full face of makeup. And . . . this stuff works! I found the mist to be extremely fine, and though I could hardly believe that it wasn’t ruining my foundation, it leaves not a trace on my face (though it looks and feels oily on, say, my chest, and also my hair). The hair is annoying. But if you just carry a cheap cotton scarf like a bandana and tie it around your hair for 30 seconds while you spray, it’s no big deal.

I really enjoy this product!  It has a thinner consistency and blends into the skin very nicely.  It’s not sticky and applies easily onto the skin.  I love how soft it makes my skin and I believe over time and consistent use, it could plump the neck area making it look more smooth and less aged.

Great for covering up redness and had similar finish to a medium coverage foundation. Loved it for day to day but very heavy on the skin. Breaks me out if I wear it more than a day or two in a row, but that may be due to my sensitive skin. Other than that I really enjoy this, but use caution if you are acne prone/oily.

I love this product because it’s oil free, my skin doesn’t feel greasy and it’s perfect for every day use under makeup. The product is light and spreads on easy, it provides excellent sun protection and is perfect at making my skin matte and primed for an application of makeup. My skin feels hydrated after application and removal. Highly recommend!

I received a sample sachet from Ranavat and tried it, this product has a nice texture and moisturizes my skin without making it feel heavy. I was a bit skeptical to try heavy creams like this as it normally doesn’t work on my oily skin, but this melted into my skin and didn’t make if feel greasy.

This is the most amazing moisturizer I have ever used. I have dry/normal skin. This is a perfect medium if the B-Hydra isn’t enough moisture, but the LaLa Retro is too thick for you. I live where there is a lot of heat and humidity, so while I love the LaLa Retro in winter, it can be too heavy most of the time.

I love this completely pure, lightweight oil. I used to put it on under my regular moisturizer, but now I just use it on its own. Super hydrating. Skin glows. Doesn’t clog my pores at all, and actually seems to improve the tone of my skin. Light, natural scent that I don’t even notice anymore. I’ve used it on my hair, too. I gave it as a gift over the holidays -- that’s how much I think people will like it!

It’s hard to find mineral SPFs that don’t make you look like a ghost. This is especially difficult if you have dark skin. I gave up on them a while ago. Since zinc oxide is naturally white, there isn’t too much that can be done about the white cast issue in mineral sunscreens. But I decided to give this a shot, and I was pleasantly surprised! For reference I’m an NC46/47 in terms of skin tone. So this does leave a cast, it is *not* completely sheer, but like I mentioned before, that’s pretty much impossible with current physical SPF technology, so it’s unfair to judge it completely on that. But for my skin tone, the case was extremely faint. If you regularly wear makeup, this is perfect for you. I found that layering a couple drops of a skin tint in my skintone shade on top of this was enough to counteract the slight cast. And even without makeup, I would be comfortable wearing this around the house, or on quick errands. I’ve not yet tested this to see if it’s sweatproof, but it’s more on the matte side than it is greasy, so I am optimistic it will hold up in the summer heat. All in all, if you’re looking for a good mineral sunscreen that leaves as minimal a cast as can be expected, this is it. It’s a beautiful formula that wears super well. The verdict of whether it will work for you mostly depends on what you’re looking for in an SPF product.

I have been looking for a new cleanser that was considered “clean”- I finally found it. This is by far THE BEST cleanser I have ever used (and I loved my previous cleanser). I will never go back to anything else.  It feels unusual at first because it turns oily but it washes off really nice (I use a wash cloth) and leaves no residue. My skin feels very balanced (not stripped or dry) and there is no trace of make up left on your skin. The jar is a good size and you don’t need a lot of product so it should last. I highly recommend this product and I will never use another cleanser for my face.

Wow this stuff feels so good!!! And a little goes a very long way. I grabbed less than I do for my normal moisturizer and it was still more than I needed! This will last a very long time, even though I only have a small container of it. It felt very smooth and velvety when I put it on and my face feels nice afterward. I recommend giving this a try! It didn’t feel quite as thick and hydrating as my other moisturizers that are specific to dry skin, so this is probably not the best if you have super dry skin or don’t moisturize on a regular basis. It’s definitely good for those with a strict routine, though.

Ever since I bought it, it’s been a part of my essentials. My skin is sensitive, super dry in the winter, eczema prone, yearns for moisture on planes, and is a crazy combo of oily/dry in the summer. I use this on not only my face, but my cuticles and hands ESPECIALLY in the winter AND on airplanes! It’s hydrating and just plain amazing. Thank you SO much for this product!

I received this as a #freeproduct from #trywithtopbox and I was not as impressed as others to be honest. I have what you would consider to be super oily skin and this did not really help control my oily face nor did it do anything to minimize my pores as it advertises as part of its active ingredients. It claims to be clean and fragrance free but I could smell a minty scent which I did not mind at all to be honest. It was quite soothing. I only wish it would actually help mattify my skin.
The perfect light weight sunscreen with an amazing finish!

I’ve been using this for about two weeks and it has done amazing things for my face. I have combination skin - oily T-zone and dry around my cheeks. This has helped my skin to look and feel amazing. A little bit goes a long way, so it will definitely last awhile!

This cream is fantastic and a Must Try. It will calm, soothe, smooth, protect and nourish you beautifully, and by no means be any less satisfying to use than a fancy and elaborately formulated, hi-technological, kitchen-sink or secret, miraculous ingredient $$$$$ pot of goodness.Everyone should have one.My skin is very fussy; sensitive, oily, dry, red, breakout prone and hard to please, but this cream is my Go To when all others fail.

It is very nourishing for the skin without being excessively oily. I use it all over my face, neck and my chest. I have very dry red patches on my knees and ankles and this oil just works wonders on those areas.I have also started mixing the argan oil with my body lotion. It truly is an amazing product and worth every penny. But, please remember a little bit does go a long way. When the oil is heated by your body temparture it spreads very easily.

This product is great if you struggle with sensitive acne prone skin. It works great for melting down makeup and doesn’t break me out at all after using it as most makeup removers have done. The only issue is that is expensive and even if I buy the bigger size I can go through it quickly because I usually wear makeup. I would like to find a cheaper alternative. I would recommend this for people who don’t wear makeup often and wear light makeup. what I like about this is that it comes with a scoop and feels very lightweight. Would continue to buy this all the time if it was less expensive or they gave more for the price I paid.

I have been using this in the winter months and it’s wonderful, but I’ve noticed that since spring is approaching and the winter is slowly leaving, it’s not really necessary to use a cream this thick. I have slightly oily skin that is prone to breakouts, and I just find that this is slightly too heavy for my skin type. If you have drier skin, you might want to give this a try as this is pretty hydrating.

I have a combination skin type and this primer was too oily for me.It did nothing to last my makeup.I feel its just a heavy moisturizer.I had a oily makeup  face by the end of day with this primer underneath.

I love this stuff!! I got it in a Sephora favorites kit but the full size came in it! I love the concept of it being a stick, which means no need to get your hands dirty! I love the sensation when you put it on, temp wise it has a cooling sensation (im gonna try putting it in the fridge like it suggests for extra cooling effects) and feels like it goes from solid to water.. it’s a great wake up/pick me up for the skin! I see people saying it’s sticky, I just think initially it is thick, but once it sinks in you can barely notice, maybe it’s just because I have chronically dry skin. It also doesn’t feel heavy on my skin at all. I think this would be great under makeup!

I am going to buy a backup for this product! I have very sensitive dry skin that is prone to flaking. I have a hard time finding a moisturizer that doesn’t irritate my skin for feel super heavy. This moisturizer is AMAZING! It’s super hydrating and feels like I have nothing on. It dries down super Matte and looks flawless under foundation. I received this product for free for my honest opinion

I really like the substance of this cleanser itself, but the packaging is a miss. I’ve ordered it twice and had to request a replacement each time because the pump just doesn’t work, and the product is so thick you can’t get it out without the pump. Aside from that, the cleanser is very foamy and leaves my skin feeling thoroughly cleansed. I also like the fresh scent and natural ingredients.

I love how this comes out with a tint but goes on sheer. It’s great for a primer or just an everyday moisturizer that has a nice subtle glow. It’s not thick at all doesn’t flake or bunch up it provides a very subtle healthy shine for your no makeup days.

This product has filled a hole in my skincare routine! I have oily/combo dehydrated skin so I’m always looking for lightweight products that provide a boost of hydration. I love mixing a pump of this with another serum; I feel it helps other products absorb better. A little goes a long way, this will last forever. I will definitely repurchase once this runs out.

I’ve heard many great things about this for reducing oil on the skin, hyperpigmentation, pore size and even helping with blemishes. I personally used this product in the morning and a prescription retinol at night for acne. I’m sure this works for others, but in my case.. i’m almost done with the bottle and i don’t notice a difference. if anything my skin is more oily than usual. On active breakouts ive noticed that this serum helps dry out the dead skin on top to possibly promote healing of the acne. It didn’t do much for me, but that could be due to the prescription I use at night that already helps with the claims stated above. Will not be repurchasing anytime soon, but open to trying it again later down the line.
I wanted to love this because I love the convenience of a mist but it left my skin feeling sticky. I’m going to try a couple more times right after washing my face to see if that helps.

I love this stuff! It takes a little while to get used to the smell but other than that I love it. It doesn’t leave your skin greasy and the pigment doesn’t show up on your skin but it does reduce the redness. It leaves my skin hydrated and I have noticed a difference in my complexion and texture. I recommend trying this product if you have oily, acne prone skin!

This baby is Thick and creamy and melts into my dry skin! It is perfect for the upcoming fall and winter weather. It works so great for my skin and has the same packaging as other products with a magnetic lid and a spatula. The cream itself is so decadent but doesn’t feel heavy on the skin once applied. Absolutely love this new moisturizer! I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty.

So I got a travel size and I really like it. I also thought by mistake this was a face and body product. I’ve only used it on my face a couple of times and I really liked it. I also have very dry skin so I don’t know if anyone would feel differently if they aren’t as dry. I gave it four stars because I have yet to try it as intended, on my body. It’s not sticky and I love the lush glow to my skin. I think I will like this on top or alone as spf when traveling or spending more time outside.
The product was too thick for my liking. I love grapefruit anything but this lip balm did not do grapefruit justice. It did the job but not well.

This product was gifted by Dermalogica in exchange for my honest review. I love the lightweight milky texture. It blends into the skin seamlessly and makes my skin feel hydrated! It’s like a bottle of water for the face. The dropper makes it so easy to apply.

MY FAVORITE CLEANSER!!!I got the sample for my birthday and after using the cleanser once I noticed a huge difference in my skin. I felt like for once my skin was ACTUALLY clean.
